model_ids <- c("UT-GBQR", "epiforecasts-dyngam", "NAU-Copycat",
    "UMass-alloy", "NAU-INFLAenza", "UMass-SAR", "VTSanghani-PRIME",
    "epiENGAGE-baseline", "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean")

Left

standard_coverage <- read.csv("C:/Projects/ForecastEvaluation/Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
standard_coverage <- standard_coverage |>
    select(location, target_end_date, horizon, reference_date,
        model_id, target, coverage_95, prediction_category) |>
    mutate(horizon = horizon + 1)

temp3a <- standard_wis %>%
    left_join(standard_coverage, by = join_by(location, target_end_date,
        horizon, reference_date, model_id, target)) %>%
    filter(model_id %in% model_ids)

table(is.na(temp3a$prediction_category))
## 
## FALSE 
## 63808
temp3a$model_id <- factor(temp3a$model_id, levels = model_ids)
plot_df <- temp3a %>%
    group_by(model_id, prediction_category) %>%
    summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    mutate(total_wis = sum(mean_wis)) %>%
    ungroup()

plot_df$prediction_category <- factor(plot_df$prediction_category,
    levels = c("over", "on-target", "under"))
figure3a = ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = model_id, y = mean_wis, fill = prediction_category)) +
    geom_col() + coord_flip() + labs(x = "Model (all horizons)",
    y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Prediction Category") + theme_bw(base_size = 18)
figure3a

Top right

temp3b = standard_coverage |>
    group_by(model_id, horizon) |>
    summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(model_id) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(model_id %in% model_ids)

temp3b$model_id <- factor(temp3b$model_id, levels = model_ids)
figure3b = ggplot(temp3b) + geom_tile(aes(y = model_id, x = horizon,
    fill = mean_coverage)) + scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "plasma",
    direction = -1) + theme_bw(base_size = 18) + labs(x = "Horizon (1-4)",
    y = "Model", fill = "Mean Coverage (95%)")
figure3b

Bottom right

temp3c = standard_wis |>
    group_by(target_end_date, model_id, horizon) |>
    summarize(mean_wis = mean(wis, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    filter(model_id %in% model_ids)

temp3c$target_end_date = as.Date(temp3c$target_end_date)

temp3c$model_id <- factor(temp3c$model_id, levels = model_ids)
figure3c = ggplot() + geom_line(data = subset(temp3c, model_id !=
    "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean"), aes(target_end_date, mean_wis,
    color = model_id), linewidth = 1) + geom_line(data = subset(temp3c,
    model_id == "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean"), aes(target_end_date,
    mean_wis, color = model_id), linewidth = 1.2) + scale_color_manual(values = c(setNames((scales::hue_pal())(length(unique(temp3c$model_id)) -
    1), setdiff(unique(temp3c$model_id), "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean")),
    `epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean` = "black")) + labs(y = "Mean WIS",
    x = "Date", color = "Model") + scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b %Y") + facet_wrap(~horizon, labeller = labeller(horizon = as_labeller(function(x) paste("Horizon",
    x)))) + theme_bw() + theme(text = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16), legend.title = element_text(size = 17),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 17))

figure3c
